memo.headline: Prioritize GiveDirectly for impact evidence, but ask all three charities for comparable outcomes and cost-per-outcome data before choosing.
memo.summary: GiveDirectly has the strongest impact-evidence rating in the rubric, but the reviewed material does not establish that its cash-transfer approach delivers more impact per dollar than alternatives. Feeding America reports large self-reported distribution outputs, while the reviewed MSF result indicates emergency-response activity; neither establishes measured outcomes or comparative cost-effectiveness. Transparency and cost discipline also matter to you: ask each organization for current financial information and the share of expenses devoted to programs. None of the three charities is identified as a DEMO charity.
memo.recommendation: Make any gift conditional on getting a clear explanation of how the charity measures outcomes, relates them to spending, and compares its results with alternatives. Start with GiveDirectly’s independently replicated findings and cost-per-outcome analysis; ask Feeding America how its output measures relate to sustained food-security outcomes, and ask MSF-USA which health outcomes it tracks and how effectiveness is assessed. For each, request the program-services share from the latest Form 990 and current financial information.

CALC-271661997-total_revenue_latest.label: Total revenue (latest year)

CALC-271661997-total_expenses_latest.label: Total expenses (latest year)
CALC-271661997-total_expenses_latest.excerpt: Total functional expenses from the latest filing with data. FY2023: total expenses $130,260,291.

CALC-271661997-surplus_margin.label: Surplus margin (latest year)
CALC-271661997-surplus_margin.excerpt: Total revenue minus total expenses, divided by total revenue, for the latest year. FY2023: total revenue $140,343,295 minus total expenses $130,260,291, divided by total revenue = 7.2%.

CALC-271661997-avg_surplus_margin_3y.label: Average surplus margin (up to 3 latest years)
CALC-271661997-avg_surplus_margin_3y.excerpt: Mean of the yearly surplus margins over up to the 3 newest filings (needs at least 2). Mean of FY2023 7.2%, FY2022 -48.7%, FY2021 22.5% = -6.3%.

CALC-271661997-net_assets_months.label: Reserves proxy (net assets in months of expenses)
CALC-271661997-net_assets_months.excerpt: Net assets divided by monthly expenses (total expenses / 12) for the latest year. This is a reserves proxy: net assets can include buildings and restricted funds that cannot pay for operations. FY2023: net assets $123,342,535 divided by monthly expenses ($130,260,291 / 12 = $10,855,024) = 11.4 months.

CALC-271661997-liabilities_to_assets.label: Liabilities to assets
CALC-271661997-liabilities_to_assets.excerpt: Total liabilities divided by total assets for the latest year. FY2023: total liabilities (end of year) $79,756,067, divided by total assets (end of year) $203,098,602 = 39.3%.

CALC-271661997-revenue_cagr_3y.label: Revenue growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-271661997-revenue_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total revenue since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total revenue went from $306,474,046 in FY2020 to $140,343,295 in FY2023 over 3 years: ($140,343,295 / $306,474,046) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = -22.9% per year.

CALC-271661997-expense_cagr_3y.label: Expense growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-271661997-expense_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total expenses since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total expenses went from $229,810,731 in FY2020 to $130,260,291 in FY2023 over 3 years: ($130,260,291 / $229,810,731) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = -17.2% per year.

CALC-271661997-revenue_volatility_cv.label: Revenue volatility (coefficient of variation, up to 5 years)
CALC-271661997-revenue_volatility_cv.excerpt: Sample standard deviation of total revenue divided by its mean, over up to the 5 newest filings (needs at least 3). Total revenue for FY2019 to FY2023 (5 filings): standard deviation $101,430,224 divided by mean $184,362,350 = 55.0%.

CALC-271661997-contributions_share.label: Contributions and grants as a share of revenue
CALC-271661997-contributions_share.excerpt: Contributions and grants divided by total revenue for the latest year. FY2023: contributions and grants $125,494,389, divided by total revenue $140,343,295 = 89.4%.

CALC-271661997-revenue_concentration_hhi.label: Revenue concentration index (HHI across 4 sources)
CALC-271661997-revenue_concentration_hhi.excerpt: Sum of squared shares of four revenue sources (contributions, program service revenue, investment income, other) for the latest year. Negative sources count as 0. 1.0 means a single source. FY2023 shares: contributions 89.4%, program service revenue 0.0%, investment income 1.4%, other revenue 9.2%. Sum of squared shares = 0.808.

CALC-271661997-officer_comp_share.label: Officer compensation as a share of expenses
CALC-271661997-officer_comp_share.excerpt: Compensation of current officers and key employees divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2023: compensation of current officers and key employees $1,598,399, divided by total expenses $130,260,291 = 1.2%.

CALC-271661997-staff_cost_share.label: Staff costs as a share of expenses (officers, salaries, payroll tax)
CALC-271661997-staff_cost_share.excerpt: Officer compensation plus other salaries and wages plus payroll taxes, divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2023: compensation of current officers and key employees $1,598,399 + other salaries and wages $24,719,567 + payroll taxes $2,075,996 = $28,393,962 in staff costs, divided by total expenses $130,260,291 = 21.8%.

CALC-271661997-pro_fundraising_fee_share.label: Professional fundraising fees as a share of contributions
CALC-271661997-pro_fundraising_fee_share.excerpt: Professional fundraising fees divided by contributions and grants, latest year. FY2023: professional fundraising fees $135,175, divided by contributions and grants $125,494,389 = 0.1%.

CALC-271661997-filing_recency_years.label: Years since the latest filing with data
CALC-271661997-filing_recency_years.excerpt: Current calendar year minus the tax year of the latest filing with data. 2026 minus FY2023 = 3.

CALC-271661997-years_of_filings.label: Years of filings with data
CALC-271661997-years_of_filings.excerpt: Number of tax years with Form 990 data in the ProPublica extract. Tax years with data: 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, 2013, 2012, 2011 (13).

CALC-271661997-program_expense_share.label: Program expense share
CALC-271661997-program_expense_share.excerpt: Program service expenses divided by total expenses. Not computed: Not in the free IRS extract (Form 990 Part IX, column B). Ask the charity or read the filing PDF.

CALC-133433452-total_revenue_latest.label: Total revenue (latest year)
CALC-133433452-total_revenue_latest.excerpt: Total revenue from the latest filing with data. FY2023: total revenue $767,362,916.

CALC-133433452-total_expenses_latest.label: Total expenses (latest year)
CALC-133433452-total_expenses_latest.excerpt: Total functional expenses from the latest filing with data. FY2023: total expenses $856,531,073.

CALC-133433452-surplus_margin.label: Surplus margin (latest year)
CALC-133433452-surplus_margin.excerpt: Total revenue minus total expenses, divided by total revenue, for the latest year. FY2023: total revenue $767,362,916 minus total expenses $856,531,073, divided by total revenue = -11.6%.

CALC-133433452-avg_surplus_margin_3y.label: Average surplus margin (up to 3 latest years)
CALC-133433452-avg_surplus_margin_3y.excerpt: Mean of the yearly surplus margins over up to the 3 newest filings (needs at least 2). Mean of FY2023 -11.6%, FY2022 5.7%, FY2021 7.6% = 0.6%.

CALC-133433452-net_assets_months.label: Reserves proxy (net assets in months of expenses)
CALC-133433452-net_assets_months.excerpt: Net assets divided by monthly expenses (total expenses / 12) for the latest year. This is a reserves proxy: net assets can include buildings and restricted funds that cannot pay for operations. FY2023: net assets $263,589,512 divided by monthly expenses ($856,531,073 / 12 = $71,377,589) = 3.7 months.

CALC-133433452-liabilities_to_assets.label: Liabilities to assets
CALC-133433452-liabilities_to_assets.excerpt: Total liabilities divided by total assets for the latest year. FY2023: total liabilities (end of year) $238,377,697, divided by total assets (end of year) $501,967,209 = 47.5%.

CALC-133433452-revenue_cagr_3y.label: Revenue growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-133433452-revenue_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total revenue since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total revenue went from $558,340,480 in FY2020 to $767,362,916 in FY2023 over 3 years: ($767,362,916 / $558,340,480) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = 11.2% per year.

CALC-133433452-expense_cagr_3y.label: Expense growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-133433452-expense_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total expenses since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total expenses went from $499,587,775 in FY2020 to $856,531,073 in FY2023 over 3 years: ($856,531,073 / $499,587,775) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = 19.7% per year.

CALC-133433452-revenue_volatility_cv.label: Revenue volatility (coefficient of variation, up to 5 years)
CALC-133433452-revenue_volatility_cv.excerpt: Sample standard deviation of total revenue divided by its mean, over up to the 5 newest filings (needs at least 3). Total revenue for FY2019 to FY2023 (5 filings): standard deviation $128,068,891 divided by mean $619,610,996 = 20.7%.

CALC-133433452-contributions_share.label: Contributions and grants as a share of revenue
CALC-133433452-contributions_share.excerpt: Contributions and grants divided by total revenue for the latest year. FY2023: contributions and grants $744,652,791, divided by total revenue $767,362,916 = 97.0%.

CALC-133433452-revenue_concentration_hhi.label: Revenue concentration index (HHI across 4 sources)
CALC-133433452-revenue_concentration_hhi.excerpt: Sum of squared shares of four revenue sources (contributions, program service revenue, investment income, other) for the latest year. Negative sources count as 0. 1.0 means a single source. FY2023 shares: contributions 96.8%, program service revenue 1.7%, investment income 1.4%, other revenue 0.0%. Sum of squared shares = 0.938.

CALC-133433452-officer_comp_share.label: Officer compensation as a share of expenses
CALC-133433452-officer_comp_share.excerpt: Compensation of current officers and key employees divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2023: compensation of current officers and key employees $3,105,482, divided by total expenses $856,531,073 = 0.4%.

CALC-133433452-staff_cost_share.label: Staff costs as a share of expenses (officers, salaries, payroll tax)
CALC-133433452-staff_cost_share.excerpt: Officer compensation plus other salaries and wages plus payroll taxes, divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2023: compensation of current officers and key employees $3,105,482 + other salaries and wages $27,905,557 + payroll taxes $2,305,945 = $33,316,984 in staff costs, divided by total expenses $856,531,073 = 3.9%.

CALC-133433452-pro_fundraising_fee_share.label: Professional fundraising fees as a share of contributions
CALC-133433452-pro_fundraising_fee_share.excerpt: Professional fundraising fees divided by contributions and grants, latest year. FY2023: professional fundraising fees $25,728,499, divided by contributions and grants $744,652,791 = 3.5%.

CALC-133433452-filing_recency_years.label: Years since the latest filing with data
CALC-133433452-filing_recency_years.excerpt: Current calendar year minus the tax year of the latest filing with data. 2026 minus FY2023 = 3.

CALC-133433452-years_of_filings.label: Years of filings with data
CALC-133433452-years_of_filings.excerpt: Number of tax years with Form 990 data in the ProPublica extract. Tax years with data: 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, 2013, 2012, 2011 (13).

CALC-133433452-program_expense_share.label: Program expense share
CALC-133433452-program_expense_share.excerpt: Program service expenses divided by total expenses. Not computed: Not in the free IRS extract (Form 990 Part IX, column B). Ask the charity or read the filing PDF.

CALC-363673599-surplus_margin.label: Surplus margin (latest year)
CALC-363673599-surplus_margin.excerpt: Total revenue minus total expenses, divided by total revenue, for the latest year. FY2023: total revenue $4,916,912,461 minus total expenses $4,933,690,967, divided by total revenue = -0.3%.

CALC-363673599-avg_surplus_margin_3y.label: Average surplus margin (up to 3 latest years)
CALC-363673599-avg_surplus_margin_3y.excerpt: Mean of the yearly surplus margins over up to the 3 newest filings (needs at least 2). Mean of FY2023 -0.3%, FY2022 0.8%, FY2021 4.0% = 1.5%.

CALC-363673599-net_assets_months.label: Reserves proxy (net assets in months of expenses)
CALC-363673599-net_assets_months.excerpt: Net assets divided by monthly expenses (total expenses / 12) for the latest year. This is a reserves proxy: net assets can include buildings and restricted funds that cannot pay for operations. FY2023: net assets $563,899,769 divided by monthly expenses ($4,933,690,967 / 12 = $411,140,914) = 1.4 months.

CALC-363673599-liabilities_to_assets.label: Liabilities to assets
CALC-363673599-liabilities_to_assets.excerpt: Total liabilities divided by total assets for the latest year. FY2023: total liabilities (end of year) $62,229,963, divided by total assets (end of year) $626,129,732 = 9.9%.

CALC-363673599-revenue_cagr_3y.label: Revenue growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-363673599-revenue_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total revenue since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total revenue went from $3,571,430,346 in FY2020 to $4,916,912,461 in FY2023 over 3 years: ($4,916,912,461 / $3,571,430,346) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = 11.2% per year.

CALC-363673599-expense_cagr_3y.label: Expense growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-363673599-expense_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total expenses since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total expenses went from $3,309,075,710 in FY2020 to $4,933,690,967 in FY2023 over 3 years: ($4,933,690,967 / $3,309,075,710) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = 14.2% per year.

CALC-363673599-revenue_volatility_cv.label: Revenue volatility (coefficient of variation, up to 5 years)
CALC-363673599-revenue_volatility_cv.excerpt: Sample standard deviation of total revenue divided by its mean, over up to the 5 newest filings (needs at least 3). Total revenue for FY2019 to FY2023 (5 filings): standard deviation $781,192,570 divided by mean $3,930,504,667 = 19.9%.

CALC-363673599-contributions_share.label: Contributions and grants as a share of revenue
CALC-363673599-contributions_share.excerpt: Contributions and grants divided by total revenue for the latest year. FY2023: contributions and grants $4,752,844,795, divided by total revenue $4,916,912,461 = 96.7%.

CALC-363673599-revenue_concentration_hhi.label: Revenue concentration index (HHI across 4 sources)
CALC-363673599-revenue_concentration_hhi.excerpt: Sum of squared shares of four revenue sources (contributions, program service revenue, investment income, other) for the latest year. Negative sources count as 0. 1.0 means a single source. FY2023 shares: contributions 96.7%, program service revenue 2.1%, investment income 0.1%, other revenue 1.2%. Sum of squared shares = 0.935.

CALC-363673599-officer_comp_share.label: Officer compensation as a share of expenses
CALC-363673599-officer_comp_share.excerpt: Compensation of current officers and key employees divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2023: compensation of current officers and key employees $7,068,165, divided by total expenses $4,933,690,967 = 0.1%.

CALC-363673599-staff_cost_share.label: Staff costs as a share of expenses (officers, salaries, payroll tax)
CALC-363673599-staff_cost_share.excerpt: Officer compensation plus other salaries and wages plus payroll taxes, divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2023: compensation of current officers and key employees $7,068,165 + other salaries and wages $42,446,480 + payroll taxes $3,519,394 = $53,034,039 in staff costs, divided by total expenses $4,933,690,967 = 1.1%.

CALC-363673599-pro_fundraising_fee_share.label: Professional fundraising fees as a share of contributions
CALC-363673599-pro_fundraising_fee_share.excerpt: Professional fundraising fees divided by contributions and grants, latest year. FY2023: professional fundraising fees $1,609,306, divided by contributions and grants $4,752,844,795 = 0.0%.

CALC-363673599-filing_recency_years.label: Years since the latest filing with data
CALC-363673599-filing_recency_years.excerpt: Current calendar year minus the tax year of the latest filing with data. 2026 minus FY2023 = 3.

CALC-363673599-years_of_filings.label: Years of filings with data
